document: Rustad's rocky road: Half of the BC Conservative Party's 2024 voters say they want him to go (Angus Reid Institute, 2025-10-26)
note: Online, Angus Reid Forum, n=1,044. Shares among decided voters (will support + leaners) from the tables (2025.10.26_BC_Rustad_tables.pdf, QBC7+QBC8). n = decided bases printed in the table (single base row, weighting status not stated). Blank cells (zero responses) recorded as 0. AUTRES = 'Another provincial party (specify)'. Region labels verbatim; 'Fraser Valley' is ARI's Lower Mainland outside Metro Vancouver; 'Island/ North Coast' coded VANCOUVER-ISLAND-NORTH-COAST.
